title: Word Break
statement: Return true when s can be cut into a sequence of dictionary words. Words may be reused, and not every dictionary word has to be used.
hints: Plain recursion re-solves the same suffixes over and over and blows up exponentially. The stress case is built to punish exactly that.
Define reachable[i] as: the first i characters can be segmented. reachable[0] is true.
reachable[end] is true when some earlier reachable[start] is true and the slice from start to end is in the dictionary. Put the dictionary in a HashSet.
complexity: O(n^2) time with O(1) dictionary lookups
